Subject: Implementing CCPAP Module in Current A/c No. 02.

Sir / Madam,

The CCPAP Module for payment has been implemented in A/c No. 1, 10 &
21 in all offices to prevent frauds.

2. Now, the CCPAP Module is to be implemented in Current A/c No. 02 in all
field offices. For this purpose issuing Type-29 cheques in Current A/c No. 02 is required.
You are therefore, requested to ensure and confirm that Type 29 cheque leaves are issued
by the Bank in Current A/c No. 02.

3: The date of implementation of CCPAP Module in A/c No. 02 shall be
informed separately.

Yours faithfully
